DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。展示について何をご質問になりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to ask about the exhibit?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この道具の横にある名前は、作った人ですか。見学メモに製作者として書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 展示横の名前を製作者としてメモしたが正しいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Is the name beside this tool the person who made it? I wrote it in my visit notes as the maker.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you were correct to note the name beside the exhibit as its maker. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その欄は寄贈者で、博物館へ提供した方のお名前です。製作者の欄は別にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: That field names the donor, the person who gave it to the museum. There is a separate field for the maker.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 作った人と、提供した人は同じとは限らないんですね。製作者の欄を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 製作者と寄贈者が同じとは限らないと理解し、製作者欄を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the maker and donor aren't necessarily the same person. I'd like to see the maker field.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that you understand the maker and donor may differ, and look for the maker field. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらには製作者不明とあります。寄贈者のお名前で補うことはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: It says 'maker unknown' here. We can't fill it in with the donor's name.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 不明のまま記録します。メモの製作者名は消して、寄贈者の欄へ移します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 製作者は不明と残し、誤記した名前を寄贈者欄へ移すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll record it as unknown. I'll remove the name I wrote as the maker and move it to the donor field.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will leave the maker unknown and move the incorrectly recorded name to the donor field. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その区別でご覧ください。年代はこの別の欄に説明があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep that distinction in mind. The period is explained in this separate field.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 年代も、名前から想像せず表示を読みます。この道具の使い方の解説はどこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 年代は表示で確認し、道具用途の説明場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll read the date information rather than guess from the name, too. Where is the explanation of how this tool was used?
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the period from the display and ask where the tool's use is explained. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 右側の札に用途の説明があります。元の持ち主や製作者を示すものではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The label on the right explains its use. It doesn't identify the original owner or maker.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 用途、年代、寄贈者を別々にメモしました。製作者はわからないと残し、友人への説明も直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 用途年代寄贈者を分け、製作者不明として友人への説明も訂正すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've noted its use, period, and donor separately. I'll leave the maker unknown and correct what I told my friend, too.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will distinguish use, period, and donor, record the maker as unknown, and correct your explanation to your friend. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご質問ありがとうございました。引き続き展示をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for your question. Please continue enjoying the exhibits.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: おはようございます。作業の報告で確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Good morning. Is there anything you want to check in your work report?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 苗箱の数を報告したいですが、運ぶ前の数と残った数を足してしまいそうです。記録を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 苗箱の運搬前数と残数を足しそうなので報告記録の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to report the number of seedling trays, but I might add the number before transport to the number left. Please check my record.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to check the report record because you might add the starting and remaining seedling-tray counts. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 運ぶ前はいくつで、今はいくつ残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: How many were there before transport, and how many remain now?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 最初は三十箱で、今は十二箱残っています。四十二箱あるという意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 開始三十、残り十二で、合計四十二という意味ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thirty initially, and twelve remain now. That doesn't mean there are forty-two trays.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the starting count was thirty and twelve remain, not a combined forty-two. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同じ箱を時間を変えて数えた記録ですね。運んだ箱の数も控えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Those are records of the same trays counted at different times, then. Did you also record the transported quantity?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、運搬の控えは十八箱です。三十から十八を運んで、十二残ったと一致します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 運搬控え十八と照合し、開始三十から十八運び十二残ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, the transport record says eighteen. Thirty initially, eighteen transported, and twelve left is consistent.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Compare with the transport record of eighteen and say that thirty minus eighteen transported leaves twelve. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その三つの数を、開始数、運搬数、残数の欄に分けて書けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can write those three numbers in separate fields for starting, transported, and remaining quantities.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それぞれの欄へ書きます。十二箱も運び終えたとは報告せず、まだ置き場に残っていると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 三欄を分け、残り十二を運搬済みとは報告しないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll write each in its own field. I won't report the twelve as transported as well; I'll say they're still in the storage area.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm separating the three fields and not reporting the remaining twelve as already transported. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 残りは次の班が運ぶ予定です。どこに置いたかも引き継いでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The next team plans to move the remainder. Please also hand over where you put them.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三十から十八を運搬し、十二は入口横に残っています。次の班へ場所と残数を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 残り十二の入口横という場所も次班へ引き継ぐと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Eighteen of thirty have been moved, and twelve remain beside the entrance. I'll tell the next team the location and remaining count.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will tell the next team the remaining twelve are beside the entrance. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容で記録しました。数を分けて確認してくれてありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've recorded that. Thank you for checking the numbers separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。診察前に何をお伝えになりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to tell us before your consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 薬の袋を持ってきましたが、家族の名前でした。私が使った薬の資料として出さないよう訂正したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持参薬袋は家族名で、自分の使用資料として出さないよう訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought a medicine bag, but it has a family member's name. I'd like to correct that so I don't submit it as a record of medicine I used.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct the fact that the medicine bag belongs to a family member so it isn't submitted as your own usage record. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この袋の薬をご自身で使ったことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you ever used the medicine from this bag yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 使っていません。家の同じ引き出しにあり、自分の以前の袋だと思って持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋の薬は未使用で、同じ引出しの自分の旧薬だと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. It was in the same drawer at home, and I brought it thinking it was my own old bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you haven't used this medicine and mistook the bag in the shared drawer for your own old one. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご家族の袋として分けておきましょう。ご自身が今回使った物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's keep it separate as your family member's bag. Have you used anything yourself this time?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日、前に自分に出された塗り薬を使いました。でもその袋は、今日は手元にありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 昨日自分の旧塗薬を使ったが、その袋は未持参だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yesterday I used an ointment previously prescribed to me. But I don't have its bag with me today.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you used your own previously prescribed ointment yesterday but haven't brought its bag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 名前がわからないことも診察で伝えられます。いつ、どこへ使ったかは覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can also say during the consultation that you don't know its name. Do you remember when and where you applied it?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨夜、右腕に塗りました。今の症状は左腕にもあるので、塗った場所と分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 昨夜右腕へ塗り、症状のある左腕とは分けて説明すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Last night, on my right arm. My current symptoms are on my left arm too, so I'll explain those separately from where I applied it.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you applied it to your right arm last night and will distinguish that from symptoms on your left arm. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご本人の使用状況と、家族の資料が別という点を担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll tell the staff about your own use and that the family member's documents are separate.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族の袋は使った薬として出さず、自分の薬の名前は未確認、昨夜右腕に塗ったと説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族薬を使用歴にせず、自分の薬名不明と使用時刻場所を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't submit my family member's bag as a medicine I've used. I'll explain that my medicine's name is unconfirmed and I applied it to my right arm last night.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that the family member's medicine isn't part of your usage history and give the unknown name, time, and application site of your own medicine. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。診察で確認してもらいます。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll have it checked during your consultation. Thank you for telling us.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。家具について何をご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What would you like to discuss about the furniture?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この机の大きさは気に入っていますが、注文したい色は白ではなく木目です。注文票を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 展示机と同じ大きさだが木目色希望で注文票を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I like this desk's size, but I want to order the wood-grain finish rather than white. I'd like to check the order form.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want the display desk's size in a wood-grain finish and want to check the order form. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 展示は白色ですね。こちらの注文票も白色になっています。ご購入はまだ確定していませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The display is white, and this order form also says white. You haven't finalized the purchase yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。展示の大きさを見て選びましたが、色まで同じにするつもりはありませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 購入未確定で、展示寸法を選んだが白色を選んだわけではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I chose it after looking at the display's size, but I didn't intend to choose the same color too.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the purchase is unconfirmed and you chose the display dimensions, not the white color. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 木目色の商品番号を確認します。寸法は同じで、こちらが色見本です。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the product number for the wood-grain finish. The dimensions are the same; here is the color sample.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この色を希望します。展示品そのものではなく、その商品番号の新品を注文したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 色見本を選び、展示品ではなく該当番号の新品を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like this color. I want to order a new item with that product number, not the display piece itself.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the color sample and request a new item with that number rather than the display piece. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 新品の木目色で受け付けできます。白色の注文票を訂正してお出しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can take an order for a new wood-grain item. I'll correct the white order form and give it to you.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 商品番号と木目色が一致しています。寸法も元の展示と同じと確認できました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 訂正商品番号、木目色、寸法の一致を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The product number and wood-grain finish match. I've also confirmed that the dimensions match the original display.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the corrected product number, wood-grain finish, and matching dimensions. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 配送先と希望日も、この訂正した注文票で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check the delivery address and preferred date on this corrected order form.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 住所と希望日は合っています。新品の木目色という内容で確定し、控えを残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住所希望日を確認し、新品木目色の注文を確定して控えを残すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: The address and preferred date are correct. I'll confirm the order for a new wood-grain item and keep my copy.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the address and date, confirm the new wood-grain order, and say you will keep a copy. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。訂正後の控えをお渡しします。お買上げありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Here is the corrected copy. Thank you for your purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: おはようございます。担当の清掃で確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Good morning. Is there anything you want to check about your cleaning assignment?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二〇八号室は清掃不要の表示がありますが、表にはタオル交換とあります。入室せずに確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 清掃不要表示とタオル交換の担当表があるため入室せず確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Room 208 has a 'no cleaning required' sign, but the chart says towel replacement. I'd like to check without entering.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check without entering because a no-cleaning sign differs from the towel-replacement assignment. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お客様は部屋の清掃は不要で、タオルだけの交換をご希望です。今は在室されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The guest doesn't need room cleaning and wants only the towels changed. They are in the room now.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 清掃不要だから依頼が全部なくなったとも、交換依頼だから自由に入れるとも考えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 清掃不要を全依頼取消とも交換を自由入室許可とも考えないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I won't assume that no cleaning means all requests are canceled, or that a replacement request means I can enter freely.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you won't interpret no cleaning as cancellation of all requests or towel replacement as unrestricted entry permission. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その通りです。今回は担当者が客室へ連絡し、入口でタオルを渡す約束をしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Exactly. This time the responsible staff contacted the room and arranged to hand over towels at the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入口で受け渡す分だけ準備します。使用済みを受け取る袋も用意してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入口交換用を準備し、使用済み回収袋の用意を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll prepare only what is needed for the exchange at the entrance. May I also prepare a bag for collecting the used towels?
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Prepare the entrance exchange items and check about a used-towel collection bag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、指定の袋で受け取ります。ベッドや机の清掃は今回の依頼に含めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, use the designated bag. Bed and desk cleaning aren't included in this request.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 室内清掃はせず、タオルだけです。担当表にも清掃完了ではなく交換だけと記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 室内清掃は行わずタオル交換だけと記録すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: No interior cleaning, just towels. I'll also record only replacement on the assignment chart, not completed cleaning.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not clean inside and will record towel replacement only. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その記録でお願いします。受渡しがまだなら、済んだと記入しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please record it that way. If the handover hasn't happened yet, don't mark it as done.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず準備して担当の約束どおりに受け渡します。終わってからタオル交換の実施だけを報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 約束の受渡し後に交換実施だけを報告し、未実施を完了にしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: First I'll prepare and make the handover as arranged by the staff. Only after it's finished will I report the towel replacement performed.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will report only the actual replacement after the agreed handover, not mark unfinished work complete. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。依頼範囲を確認してくれてありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for checking the scope of the request.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: おはようございます。進捗報告で何を確認したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Good morning. What would you like to check in the progress report?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 設備の点検予定が二時とあります。会議の報告に、二時に停止済みと書いてよいか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二時の点検予定を停止済みと報告してよいか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Equipment inspection is scheduled for two o'clock. I'd like to check whether I may report to the meeting that it was stopped at two.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether a scheduled two-o'clock inspection can be reported as an already completed stoppage. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予定表だけでは停止済みとは言えません。担当から実施の連絡はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The schedule alone doesn't establish that it has stopped. Have the responsible staff confirmed it was done?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだありません。二時の予定しか見ていないので、実際に止まった時刻はわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 担当連絡はなく予定しか知らず、実際の停止時刻は不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I've only seen the two-o'clock schedule, so I don't know the actual stopping time.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that there is no staff confirmation, you only know the schedule, and the actual stopping time is unknown. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 報告は点検予定として残し、実施後に担当の確認を追記してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Keep it in the report as a scheduled inspection and add the staff's confirmation after it happens.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 予定と実施を分けます。設備を見に行って自分で停止状態を判断するのではなく、担当の連絡を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予定と実施を分け、自分で設備状態を判断せず担当連絡を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll separate the plan and actual work. Rather than go and judge the equipment's stopped state myself, I'll wait for the staff to contact us.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will separate scheduled and actual work and await staff contact rather than judge the equipment state yourself. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当からいま連絡が入りました。点検は二時十分に開始し、まだ終了していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff have just contacted us. The inspection began at two ten and hasn't finished yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 開始は二時十分と書きます。予定の二時を消して置き換えるだけでなく、予定時刻も別欄に残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認された開始二時十分を実施欄に書き、二時予定も別欄で残すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll write two ten as the start time. Rather than just delete and replace the scheduled two o'clock, I'll keep the planned time in a separate field too.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will enter the confirmed two-ten start as actual and retain the two-o'clock plan in a separate field. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、予定と実施の遅れがわかる形です。終了欄は、まだ時刻を入れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, that shows the delay between planned and actual work. Please don't enter a time in the completion field yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予定二時、実施開始二時十分、終了は未確認と報告します。生産再開も完了したとは書きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予定、開始、終了未確認を分け、生産再開済みとは報告しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll report scheduled for two, actual start two ten, and completion unconfirmed. I won't write that production has already resumed either.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate scheduled time, start, and unconfirmed completion, and say you won't report production as resumed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容で会議へ伝えてください。確認してくれてありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please report that to the meeting. Thank you for checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。郵便の受取りで何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with collecting mail?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 不在票が二枚あります。荷物が二つなのか、同じ物なのか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二枚の不在票が二荷物か同一物か確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have two missed-delivery notices. I'd like to check whether there are two parcels or the same one.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to check whether two delivery notices mean two parcels or the same parcel. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それぞれの番号と日付を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you show me the number and date on each?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 日付は昨日と今日ですが、番号は同じです。宛名も両方私の名前です。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昨日今日の別日だが番号と宛名は同じと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The dates are yesterday and today, but the number is the same. Both are addressed to me, too.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the dates differ, yesterday and today, but the number and recipient match. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同じ番号の荷物について二回訪問した記録です。二個届くという意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: These record two visits for a parcel with the same number. It doesn't mean two parcels will arrive.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ一個なんですね。再配達を二件申し込まず、一個の受取り方法を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一荷物と理解し、二重再配達申込をせず一件の方法を選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: So it's the same single parcel. Rather than request redelivery twice, I'd like to choose one way to receive it.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you understand it is one parcel and will choose one receiving method without duplicate redelivery requests. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この荷物は明日の午後の再配達を依頼できます。ご在宅の時間はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can request redelivery of this parcel tomorrow afternoon. Is there a time you'll be home?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 明日の二時から四時なら家にいます。二枚目を別の荷物として登録しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 翌日二時四時の在宅枠を伝え、別荷物として登録しないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll be home from two to four tomorrow. Please don't register the second notice as a separate parcel.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give tomorrow's two-to-four availability and ask not to register a separate parcel. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 同じ番号で一件の再配達を受け付けました。明日の二時から四時の枠です。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've accepted one redelivery request under the same number for tomorrow's two-to-four slot.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一個の荷物で、その時間枠と確認しました。二枚の票は同じ番号の記録として保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同一一個と時間枠を確認し、二票は同番号の記録として保管すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've confirmed it's one parcel and that time slot. I'll keep both notices as records of the same number.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the single parcel and time slot and say you will keep both notices as records for the same number. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。明日のご在宅をお願いします。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-HANAMAKI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please be home tomorrow. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。列車について何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with trains?

DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 途中で分かれる列車に乗ります。切符には三号車とありますが、目的地へ行く側か確認したいです。
DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 分割列車の三号車の予約席が目的地側か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm taking a train that splits along the way. My ticket says car three, but I'd like to check whether that's the section going to my destination.
DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether your reserved seat in car three of a splitting train is in the section for your destination. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この案内では一、二号車が目的地側、三、四号車は別の行先です。切符の行先も見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-03.translation: According to this guide, cars one and two go to your destination, while three and four go elsewhere. Could you show me the destination on your ticket too?

DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 目的地はこちらですが、座席だけ三号車になっています。途中で大きな荷物を持って移るのは難しいです。
DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 切符の行先と座席が食い違い大荷物で途中移動が難しいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-04.translation: This is my destination, but the seat alone is listed in car three. It would be difficult to move with my large luggage along the way.
DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the ticket destination and seat conflict and that moving mid-journey with large luggage is difficult. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 座席の予約内容を係員へ照会しましょう。ご自身で一号車の空いた指定席へ座ることはしないでください。
DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's ask the staff to check the seat reservation. Please don't sit in an empty reserved seat in car one on your own.

DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、席を自分で変えません。予約した時の控えもあるので、一緒に確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 勝手に席を変えず予約控えも使って照会してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-06.translation: Of course, I won't change seats myself. I also have the booking confirmation, so please check them together.
DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you won't change seats yourself and ask for the booking confirmation to be used in the inquiry too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 控えと切符を担当へ渡します。発車までは二十分ありますので、この窓口で案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll give the confirmation and ticket to the staff. There are twenty minutes until departure, so please wait for instructions at this counter.

DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 荷物も持ってここで待ちます。同行者には、まだ三号車へ並ばず私と一緒に待つよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者も三号車へ並ばず窓口で一緒に待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll wait here with my luggage. I'll tell my companion not to queue for car three yet and to wait with me.
DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that your companion will also wait with you at the counter rather than queue for car three. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。担当が座席を確認したら、目的地側の乗車位置もご案内します。
DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. Once the staff check the seat, we'll also show you where to board the section for your destination.

DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三号車の列には進まず、座席の照会結果を待ちます。変更内容と乗車位置が決まってから二人で乗ります。
DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 座席の照会と乗車位置確定後に二人で乗ると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't join the car-three queue. I'll wait for the seat inquiry result. The two of us will board once any changes and the boarding position are settled.
DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that both of you will board after the seat inquiry and boarding position are confirmed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お二人が同じ案内で乗れるよう、担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll pass this on so the two of you can board following the same instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 会社で予約した弁当四つの受取りです。それとは別に、自分用の甘味を一つ追加したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 予約済み会社弁当四つを受け取り自分用甘味を別に追加したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.translation: I'm collecting four bentos reserved by my company. Separately, I'd like to add one sweet for myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask to collect four company-reserved bentos and add a personal sweet separately. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 予約のお名前を確認します。追加の甘味も会社のご注文に入れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.translation: I'll confirm the reservation name. Should the extra sweet also go on the company order?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 予約名はこちらです。甘味は私個人が払うので、会社の注文や控えには入れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 予約名を伝え甘味は会社の注文と控えに含めないよう指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.translation: Here's the reservation name. I'll pay for the sweet personally, so please don't include it in the company order or receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Give the reservation name and specify that the sweet must not be on the company order or receipt. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: では弁当四つと甘味一つを別会計にします。会社分の袋も分けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.translation: Then we'll bill the four bentos and one sweet separately. Would you also like the company items in a separate bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: はい。弁当は会社へそのまま渡します。甘味は私のかばんへ入れるので別の小袋をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 会社へ渡す弁当と自分の甘味を別袋にしてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.translation: Yes. I'll give the bentos to the company as they are. The sweet goes in my own bag, so a separate small bag, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask for separate bags for the company bentos and your own sweet. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 承知しました。会社分は予約どおり四つです。こちらの内容を先にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.translation: Certainly. The company order is four, as reserved. Please check these contents first.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 四つあります。会社から預かったお金で弁当を払って、その控えを会社の袋に入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 弁当四つを確認し預かった会社のお金で先に支払う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.translation: There are four. I'll pay for the bentos with the money entrusted to me by the company and put that receipt in the company bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Check the four bentos and pay for them first with the company money entrusted to you. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 弁当のお会計が済みました。続いて甘味のお支払いをお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.translation: The bento payment is complete. Next, please pay for the sweet.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: こちらは自分のお金で払います。甘味の控えは別に保管し、会社には弁当の袋だけを渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 甘味は私費で払い控えも別保管にすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.translation: I'll pay for this with my own money. I'll keep its receipt separately and give only the bento bag to the company.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Say that you will pay for the sweet yourself and keep its receipt separately too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: かしこまりました。お品物と二つのお控えをお確かめください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-02-001-SHARED-.translation: Certainly. Please check your items and both receipts. Thank you very much.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: こんにちは。展示のことで何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.translation: Hello. How can I help with the exhibits?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 友人に勧められた展示を探しています。メモのこの名前が付いた作品はどこにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 友人から渡された名前のメモで展示を探したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.translation: I'm looking for an exhibit a friend recommended. Where is the artwork with this name in my notes?
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask to find an exhibit using a name in a note from your friend. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: その名前は作者のお名前です。この作者の作品は、川の絵と祭りの絵の二つがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.translation: That's the artist's name. We have two works by this artist: a river painting and a festival painting.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 作品名ではなかったんですね。友人は、水の中に建物が映っている絵と言っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 作者名と知り友人が言った水面に建物が映る題材を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.translation: So it wasn't the work's title. My friend described a painting with a building reflected in the water.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Show that you understand it is the artist's name and describe your friend's subject of a building reflected in water. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: それなら川の絵のほうだと思われます。入口の一覧に小さな画像がありますので確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.translation: That is probably the river painting. You can check the small image in the list at the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 一覧のこの画像です。建物が水に映っているので、探していた作品はこちらだと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 一覧画像を見て目的作品の候補を指す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.translation: It's this image in the list. Since the building is reflected in the water, I think this is the work I was looking for.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Look at the list's image and point to the likely artwork. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: こちらの作品名は「川辺の朝」です。二階の展示室でご覧いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.translation: This work is titled 'Morning by the River.' You can see it in the second-floor exhibition room.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 作品名もメモへ足します。今から二階へ行きたいですが、入口から一度外へ出る必要はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 作品名を追記し二階へ館外を経ず行けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.translation: I'll add the title to my notes too. I'd like to go upstairs now. Do I need to go outside through the entrance first?
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Add the work's title and ask whether you can reach the second floor without going outside. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 館内の階段かエレベーターで進めます。外へ出ず、二階の案内に沿ってお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.translation: You can use the stairs or elevator inside. Stay inside and follow the second-floor signs.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 「川辺の朝」と画像を確認しました。館内で二階へ進み、見た後に友人へ感想を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 作品名と画像を確かめ二階で鑑賞して友人へ感想を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.translation: I've confirmed 'Morning by the River' and the image. I'll go upstairs inside the building and tell my friend my impressions after seeing it.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Confirm the title and image, view it upstairs, and tell your friend your impressions. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: どうぞご覧ください。お探しの作品が確認できてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-ICHINOSEKI-03-001-SHARED-.translation: Please enjoy it. I'm glad we could identify the work you wanted.
